title: A label-gated workflow leaves skipped check runs: whoever waits on that check must ignore them
rule: When a workflow runs on every PR event and skips its jobs until a label or condition is present, each skipped job still leaves a completed check run with conclusion `skipped` on the commit. Code that waits for that check by name (scripts/harness/ci-wait.mjs and similar) must ignore `skipped` runs, or the workflow must not produce a check with that name on the skipped path; otherwise the wait returns at once with a run that has no artifact. Test the wait with a skipped run before and after the real run.
rationale: E9.1 (#89): bench.yml ran on opened/synchronize with all jobs skipped; ci-wait added the `bench` label and read the leftover skipped `bench` check before the labeled run's job existed, so the artifact download failed and the harness got no bench numbers.
